desc: Establish that each answer is the largest divisor \(d\mid A_i\) for which at least \(K\) array elements are divisible by \(d\).
Implement an efficient frequency/multiples-count sieve up to \(M=\max A_i\).
Implement the descending-divisor assignment, visiting multiples with positive frequency.
Preserve duplicate values and original input order in the output.
Fix and validate the \(K=N\) output path.
Assess worst-case time and memory usage.
Validate the solution against all three public samples.
